No-show feeFiled by riderContested SGD 4.00Decided automatically - 548.2 s

Fee stands, driver compensated DRIVER_COMPENSATION

The fee stands. The driver is paid SGD 3.20. No refund.

From the judge's explanation

Both parties: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.20 (80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 net fee in force, per POL-NS-07).

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 3.20 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

  2. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs: 3 sampled drafts and one with the parties' positions swapped. The vote agreement is 0.75, and the outcome recorded is carried_not_unanimous.

Each draft

  • draft 3 (sampled, sides DRIVER_ADVOCATE, RIDER_ADVOCATE): Fee stands, driver compensated DRIVER_COMPENSATION, amount SGD 3.20, driver SGD 3.20, confidence 0.9
  • draft 4 (position_swapped, sides RIDER_ADVOCATE, DRIVER_ADVOCATE): Fee stands, driver compensated DRIVER_COMPENSATION, amount SGD 3.20, driver SGD 3.20, confidence 0.85

Each draft's own explanation

To both parties. The driver pressed 'arrived' at 12:29:55 and cancelled at 12:38:20 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW (EV-TRIP-00211). POL-NS-01(a) is met, and the marker was not false under POL-NS-05: the trace places the driver 18.1 to 29.3 m from the pin and stationary, nowhere near the 300 m distance trigger or the 15 km/h speed trigger, so the waiting clock is not recomputed. POL-NS-01(d) is also met (no boarding event, driver-terminated under RIDER_NO_SHOW). The case turns on limb (c). It requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 s (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 12:30:00. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00211 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.39 on issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE. It records in-geofence fixes from 12:30:00 to 12:33:40 (220 s) and from 12:36:28 to 12:38:20 (112 s), with a 168 s gap in between (12:33:40 to 12:36:28) that exceeds the 120 s limb of POL-NS-08(b) and sits inside the waiting window. Over that stretch the trace cannot read. The limb is therefore UNDECIDED over it: the rider's figure of 220 s with an 80 s shortfall is not established (the gap is a recording outage, not a fix showing the driver drove away), and the driver's figure of 500 s is not established either (that value is a first-fix-to-last-fix envelope spanning the gap, not a continuous run). The rider's POL-NS-06(i) summation point is moot because the driver does not rely on summing separate intervals. The chat log EV-CHAT-00211 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and carries the driver's message of 12:35:10 from inside the gap, between the in-geofence readings this test admits. That contemporaneous record from inside the unobserved stretch counts under POL-GEN-02(2): the confidence cap is the MAXIMUM of the two weights (1.0), not the minimum (0.39), and the impaired trace is not the only evidence, so POL-NS-08's PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling and POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged. Because limb (c) is undecided, neither a payment that needs it to hold (POL-NS-07) nor a full refund that needs it to fail (POL-NS-06) is supported. Under POL-NS-08 the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee (EV-FARE-00211; payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is split rather than allocated whole: SGD 2.00 is returned to the rider and SGD 2.00 stands. No driver compensation is payable. For completeness: POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider, because the driver replied 18 s after her 12:31:02 message, inside the 120 s window. POL-NS-03 does not apply, since the fixes lie inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius and registered_pickup_points is 1. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, the anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations against 146 completed trips, 1.4%), and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1. No referral is produced: the arrival marker was genuine, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire, and no other clause directs a review.
Both parties: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.20 (80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 net fee in force, per POL-NS-07). On the rider's case. Your central claim is that the trace shows only 220 seconds of continuous in-geofence presence (12:30:00 to 12:33:40) against the 300-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 300), so POL-NS-01(c) fails and POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full. I do not accept it. EV-GPS-00211 is impaired at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE: the 168-second gap from 12:33:40 to 12:36:28 falls inside the waiting window and exceeds the 120-second threshold in POL-NS-08(b), so the trace alone cannot show what the driver did across it. But the trace is not the only evidence for the deciding fact. The chat log EV-CHAT-00211 (COMPLETE, weight 1.0) carries the driver's message MSG-00211-004, sent at 12:35:10 - inside the gap, and ten seconds after the 300-second point measured from the first qualifying fix at 12:30:00 - reading 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you'. That is a contemporaneous record made from inside the stretch the trace left unobserved, lying between readings the trace admitted, so it bridges the gap. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence cap is therefore the maximum of the independent carriers (1.0), not the trace's 0.39, and the POL-NS-08 direction that a sole impaired carrier caps the ruling at PARTIAL_REFUND and escalates under POL-NS-09 is not engaged: the impaired trace is not the only evidence for the deciding fact. On the admitted readings - in-radius at 18.1 to 29.3 m from the pin before the gap, and in the same place after it - and on that bridge, the driver held the pickup continuously from 12:30:00 to his 12:38:20 cancellation, 500 seconds against the 300 required. Your further point that the derived 500-second 'longest qualifying run' is a first-fix-to-last-fix envelope and that the two runs can be joined only under POL-NS-06(i) is rejected. POL-NS-06(i) governs a driver who actually leaves and re-enters the arrival radius; this trace records no fix placing him outside the radius, the recorded excursion carries a fix count of 0 and a null maximum distance, and the trace notes say he is in the same place after the outage. This is one continuous presence with a recording gap, not two intervals needing summation, so the MISSING advisory (EV-ADVIS-00211-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) removes nothing the driver needs and no summing or goodwill question arises. Your rider-contact route under POL-NS-04 fails at its own limb (b): the driver answered your 12:31:02 message at 12:31:20, eighteen seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, which defeats the clause whatever the reply said. POL-NS-03 does not apply either: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1. Your point that prior_no_show_flags may not be substituted for rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is correct and I do not use it: the trailing-30-day counter is 1, below POL-NS-09(d)'s threshold of 3, and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so no escalation trigger fires. On the driver's case. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold: (a) the trip record carries an arrival event at 12:29:55; (b) the trace places you inside the 50 m STANDARD radius (closest approach 18.1 m), and the marker is not false under POL-NS-05, you being stationary at the kerb, not over 300 m from the pin and not travelling at 15 km/h; (c) the dwell was served at 500 seconds; (d) there is no boarding event, started_at and ended_at are null, and the trip was terminated by you at 12:38:20 under RIDER_NO_SHOW after the dwell elapsed. POL-NS-07 fixes your payout at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 net fee = SGD 3.20, payable because the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below the required 4) and 2/146 = 0.014 (below the required 0.08); both limbs must hold and neither does. Those are the only profile fields I use, as POL-GEN-01 requires. The trip record's wait_time_min of 8.4 minutes (504 seconds) is consistent but I do not rest on it, as it is platform telemetry that may be computed from the same measurement as the trace. POL-GEN-03: on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd carries the same figure as driver_compensation_sgd, so both are SGD 3.20; the rider's charge stands (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The monetary effect (SGD 3.20) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00 and executes on issue. No clause produces a referral: POL-NS-05 does not fire and the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW is correctly selected. Four claims were discarded at the mechanical check for citing impaired artifacts without disclosing the impairment (EV-GPS-00211 at 0.39; EV-ADVIS-00211-01 at 0.0); they are listed in the audit record. This ruling is provisional and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
To both parties: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee stands as charged, and the driver is paid SGD 3.20. Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling value that names this outcome is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and amount_sgd mirrors the compensation figure; the rider's own charge is left in place. Arrival. The driver-pressed marker at 12:29:55 is not a false arrival under POL-NS-05: at that time the trace places the vehicle 18.1 m to 29.3 m from the pin, stationary, so it was neither more than 300 m away nor moving at 15 km/h or more, and the waiting clock is not recomputed on that ground. That satisfies POL-NS-01 limb (a), and the proximity test in POL-NS-02 for the STANDARD radius of 50 m (fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m, zone class STANDARD from trip_record) is met by fixes at 6.1 m to 11.9 m accuracy, well inside the 25 m filter. Limb (d) is met: the trip record shows no boarding event, started_at and ended_at are null, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:38:20 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The dispute is limb (c), the dwell. The free waiting period in force is 300 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and POL-NS-01(c) measures it from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 12:30:00, not from the 12:29:55 tap; the derived dwell_start_offset_sec of -5 s shows the tap and the first fix are five seconds apart, so nothing turns on the choice of clock here. EV-GPS-00211 is IMPAIRED. It carries weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE: a 168-second outage from 12:33:40 to 12:36:28 falls inside the waiting window, longer than the 120-second limb of POL-NS-08(b), and coverage is 84.3 per cent. I reject the rider's reading that the effective dwell is only the 220-second first run and that the fee is therefore refundable under POL-NS-06. An impaired stretch is undecided, not a departure: this trace records no fix placing the driver outside the arrival radius at any point, the excursion entry for the gap carries fix_count 0 and max_distance_m null, and POL-NS-08 makes a gap of this kind an impairment of the trace rather than a finding that the driver drove away. I likewise reject the driver's reliance on the 500-second first-fix-to-last-fix envelope standing alone, and on trip_record.wait_time_min of 8.4 minutes: an envelope across an unobserved stretch is not by itself continuous dwell, POL-NS-12 is not available because arrival_marker is BUTTON (not GPS_AUTO), so the platform's wait timer is not a carrier independent of the exported trace, and POL-NS-06(i) summation of the separate in-geofence intervals is closed off because the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. What covers the gap is the chat log EV-CHAT-00211, which is COMPLETE at weight 1.0. MSG-00211-004 was sent by the driver at 12:35:10, from inside the unobserved stretch, between the readings the trace admitted before it (12:30:00 to 12:33:40) and after it (12:36:28 to 12:38:20); the admissibility report calls it the only unimpaired evidence bearing on what the driver was doing during the outage. A contemporaneous record from inside a stretch the test left unobserved, lying between readings the test admitted, counts as a carrier for the cap and for the sole-evidence question. It is not derived from the GPS measurement, so it is independent. The deciding fact - the driver's continuous presence at the kerb across the window - is therefore carried by the impaired trace (0.39) and by the chat log (1.0), and the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is the MAXIMUM of those two, 1.0, not the minimum. Because a second, independent artifact carries the fact, the impaired trace is not the only evidence for it: the PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling in POL-NS-08's closing sentence and the escalation in POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged, and with the cap at 1.0 the escalating floor of 0.70 is not reached. No other POL-NS-09 limb fires: no two admissible artifacts contradict each other directly on arrival, dwell or rider presence; both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the required 3; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (below). On that evidence the driver was inside the 50 m geofence from 12:30:00 until he cancelled at 12:38:20, more than the 300 seconds required, so limb (c) is satisfied and all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them: POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver's fixes lie inside the arrival radius and registered_pickup_points is 1; POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider because it fails at its own limb (b) - the driver replied at 12:31:20, eighteen seconds after the rider's 12:31:02 message, far inside the 120-second window, and messaged again at 12:35:10. POL-NS-07 then fixes the payout at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 net cancellation fee in force, that is SGD 3.20, and the fare line reconciles with the figure produced by fee_schedule.resolution_rule (POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged). The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the required count of 4, and 2 divided by completed_trips_30d of 146 is 0.014, below the required rate of 0.08. Those two profile fields are cited only for the test POL-NS-07 names, as POL-GEN-01 requires; no other profile field is used as a ground of decision. The monetary effect, SGD 3.20, does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the payment executes automatically on issue under POL-GEN-05, subject to POL-GEN-04. No clause produces a referral on these facts.
To both parties. The $4.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-00211 stands as charged, and the driver is paid $3.20 of it (80 per cent, the platform retaining the remaining $0.80). This is a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling, so amount_sgd and driver_compensation_sgd carry the same figure. Why the fee stands. The trip was accepted at 12:20:30. The driver marked 'arrived' at 12:29:55 and cancelled at 12:38:20 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW — about eight and a half minutes, against the 300-second (5-minute) free waiting period this trip's platform policy sets. His GPS places him 18.1 m to 29.3 m from the pickup pin at 6.1 m to 11.9 m reported accuracy, so he was inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius and stationary; his marker was therefore not a false arrival under POL-NS-05 (nowhere near the 300 m or 15 km/h threshold). The record shows no boarding and no trip start, and RIDER_NO_SHOW is a reason code the clause recognises. The fare line equals the fee in force, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. On those facts all four conditions of the baseline no-show test (POL-NS-01) are met and POL-NS-07 fixes the payout. The rider's objection, and why it fails. The rider's central claim was that the longest continuous run the trace records inside the pickup fence is 220 seconds (12:30:00 to 12:33:40) — 80 seconds short of the 300-second minimum — so that POL-NS-06 makes the fee unchargeable. That reading treats a recording gap as a departure, which is wrong. EV-GPS-00211 has a 168-second gap from 12:33:40 to 12:36:28, inside the waiting window; a gap longer than 120 seconds inside the window is a policy-level impairment under POL-NS-08(b), and the trace carries weight 0.39 on issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage 84.3 per cent). The trace holds no fix placing the driver outside the radius, and the 'excursion' it reports has no fixes and no measured distance — so the trace alone establishes neither that he stayed nor that he left. It therefore cannot alone prove the shortfall the rider needs; POL-NS-08(b) makes it a down-weighted carrier, not a finding of absence. The gap is bridged, so the shortfall claim fails. The chat log EV-CHAT-00211 is complete at weight 1.0 and is not a restatement of the GPS: at 12:35:10, inside the unobserved stretch and between two admitted in-fence readings, the driver wrote 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you'. A contemporaneous message written from inside the stretch the trace could not observe is independent evidence of what he was doing then (the admissibility report itself calls it the only unimpaired evidence bearing on that interval), and it would still support the finding if the trace were removed. It therefore carries the deciding fact alongside the trace, so the trace is not the only evidence for the driver's presence and the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is the maximum of the two weights — 1.0, not 0.39. On that basis the driver's in-fence presence runs from the first qualifying fix at 12:30:00 to the cancellation at 12:38:20, 500 seconds, which meets the 300-second minimum. The summing route in POL-NS-06(i) is not needed and is not used: the finding is a single continuous presence, and the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00211-01 (weight 0.0) affects only that unavailable route, so nothing is asserted against the absent artifact. The rider's other route fails on its own terms. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate her: the driver replied 18 seconds after her 12:31:02 message, well inside the clause's 120-second window, so limb (b) fails and the clause cannot apply whatever the reply said. Her full 4.00 refund claim therefore fails. The driver's own claims. I accept limb (a) (arrival event), limb (b) (inside the 50 m radius at the marker), the POL-NS-05 finding (marker not false), limb (d) (no boarding, driver-terminated under RIDER_NO_SHOW after the dwell), the chat-log bridging argument, and the POL-NS-07 computation. I do not accept the driver's alternative that trip_record.wait_time_min of 8.4 minutes is an independent carrier: this trip's arrival marker is a driver-pressed BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 does not apply, and that figure runs from the arrival tap rather than from the first qualifying in-fence fix, so it is not an independent measurement of the POL-NS-01(c) dwell. The chat log, not the trip record, is the independent carrier. POL-NS-03 has no application — the driver's stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, not outside it — and POL-NS-01's in-radius FULL_REFUND outcome is confined by that clause's own notes to a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE reason code, which this trip does not carry. Escalation, referrals and profiles. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: neither disputes_with_counterparty_90d counter reaches 2, the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (not 3 or more), the anti-farming check on driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d (2) and completed_trips_30d (146) gives 1.4 per cent, below both the count of 4 and the rate of 8 per cent, and the deciding fact is not carried by impaired evidence alone. The rider's mention of prior_no_show_flags is a context-only field under POL-GEN-01 and was not used as a ground. No clause on these facts produces a referral, so referrals is empty. Confidence.
